evals.prompt: Run the daily Nattome TikTok brief for today. Pull the top 5 viral videos in the digestive-health space, break down why each one works, and give me 3 angles per topic that I can shoot this week. Save the brief as a markdown file.
evals.expected_output: A daily discovery handoff markdown file with 5 topics, each containing: source video link + stats, virality breakdown (hook/pacing/structure/emotional trigger/why it won), and 3 Nattome angles (hook, avatar, format, product, script outline). Brand voice rules followed (named clinical study, no overclaim, format choice justified). The handoff is framed as ideation input, not the final production report.

assertions.text: Output is saved as a dated daily discovery handoff markdown file
Output is framed as ideation or handoff input, not the final production report
All 5 topics include a working TikTok URL
Each topic has a hook breakdown labeled by hook type (symptom recognition, counter-intuitive, POV, etc.)
Each topic has 3 Nattome angles
Each angle names a specific product (DH, DR, or DH-R) and explains why that product fits
Each angle picks a single avatar (Sufferer, Maintainer, or Pharmacy Browser)
Each angle picks a format (talking head, VLOG, or both) with reasoning
When clinical backing is referenced, it names UCSI University or NCT06524271 (not vague 'studies show')
No banned phrases appear in scripted angle copy: 'miracle', 'cure', 'instant fix', 'detox', 'cleanse'
If competing with Gaviscon, framing is natural-vs-chemical or long-term-vs-temporary, not name-trashing

evals.prompt: Here's a viral TikTok URL: https://www.tiktok.com/@example/video/7234567890123456789 — break it down for me and give me 3 Nattome angles based on it. (Pretend you scraped it; the URL is a placeholder.)
evals.expected_output: Single-video brief with virality breakdown + 3 Nattome angles. Skips full daily template since it's only one video.

assertions.text: Output includes hook/pacing/structure/emotional-trigger breakdown for the single video
Output includes exactly 3 Nattome angles
Each angle specifies product + avatar + format + script outline
Skill does NOT generate a fake list of 5 topics — respects the single-URL scope

evals.prompt: I don't want to run a scrape today. The trend right now is people doing 'POV: bloating after a Ramadan buka puasa buffet'. Give me 3 Nattome angles for this trend.
evals.expected_output: 3 angles for the bloating-after-buffet topic, with format choices and product tie-ins. No scraping, no fake virality stats.

assertions.text: Skill does NOT call the Apify scraper for this prompt
Output contains 3 distinct angles
DR (instant relief) is featured prominently — it's the obvious post-buffet product fit
At least one angle uses 'Both' format (the POV → reveal pattern is Nattome's strongest)
Brand voice is sincere/professional — no influencer-hype language
